gemini_description.purpose: To define the permitted installation zones for water pumps around swimming pools and water basins, specifying safe physical distances to prevent electrical hazards.
gemini_description.summary: This diagram provides a visual guide to safety zoning (Zone 0, Zone 1, and Zone 2) around both in-ground and above-ground swimming pools. It highlights that the pump may only be installed in the designated Zone 2 area, which is situated at a safe distance from the water basin.

components.name: Zone 0
components.description: The interior of the water basin or pool, including foot cleaning basins and active drainage gullies. This is a high-risk wet zone.

components.name: Zone 1
components.description: The immediate surrounding area of the basin, extending 2.0 meters horizontally from the edge of Zone 0 and 2.5 meters vertically from the ground or walking surface.

components.name: Zone 2
components.description: The highlighted/dotted area where the pump may be safely installed. It extends an additional 1.5 meters horizontally beyond Zone 1 (totaling 3.5 meters from the pool edge) and up to 2.5 meters vertically.

components.name: Feet cleaning basin
components.description: An auxiliary foot wash station situated near the pool, classified internally as Zone 0 and subjected to its own concentric Zone 1 and Zone 2 boundaries.

procedure: Identify the boundaries of the main water basin (Zone 0).
Measure a horizontal distance of 2.0 meters and a vertical height of 2.5 meters from the basin edge to establish Zone 1.
Measure an additional 1.5 meters horizontally outward from the Zone 1 boundary to mark the inner and outer limits of Zone 2.
For pools with stairs, ladders, or slides, extend Zone 1 by 1.5 meters horizontally from these structures, with a vertical height clearance of 2.5 meters.
Ensure that the pump is mounted exclusively within the highlighted Zone 2 region (between 2.0 meters and 3.5 meters away from Zone 0).

technical_details.detail: Inner radius boundary (r1) for Zone 1 is exactly 2.0 meters from the pool edge.
Outer radius boundary (r2) representing the outer limit of Zone 2 is exactly 3.5 meters from the pool edge.
The maximum vertical clearance height defining both Zone 1 and Zone 2 is 2.5 meters.
For ladders and stairs, an elevated Zone 1 clearance zone of 1.5 meters horizontal and 2.5 meters vertical is required.
Clearances near walls or barriers are indicated by S1 and S2 dimensions.

warnings.warning: The pump must only be installed in the highlighted Zone 2 areas. Do not install the pump in Zone 0 or Zone 1.
